description.en: Soil temperature, moisture, EC, salinity, N, P, K and pH over Modbus RTU (FC03, holding registers 0-7).
description.id: Suhu, kelembapan, EC, salinitas, N, P, K dan pH tanah melalui Modbus RTU (FC03, holding register 0-7).

source.document: Manual for BGT-SMPS Soil Multi-Parameter Sensor
source.revision: 2026-04-27 (date in the file name; firmware revision not stated)

description.en: Unit as printed in the manual; the manual does not define a conversion to ppm/ppt.
description.id: Satuan sesuai manual; manual tidak menyebut konversi ke ppm/ppt.

description.en: Resolution 0.01 pH; the manual states accuracy ±1 pH (p. 3).
description.id: Resolusi 0,01 pH; manual menyebut akurasi ±1 pH (hlm. 3).

notes.en: Register map taken from the manual's page 4 request/response example: FC03, start offset 0, quantity 8, defaults unit 1, 9600 8N1. Registers 8 and 9 are undocumented and are not read. The manual prints offsets, not 4xxxx labels, so no doc_address is given.
notes.id: Peta register dari contoh request/respons manual halaman 4: FC03, offset awal 0, jumlah 8, default unit 1, 9600 8N1. Register 8 dan 9 tidak terdokumentasi dan tidak dibaca. Manual mencetak offset, bukan label 4xxxx, sehingga doc_address tidak diisi.

notes.en: N, P and K are printed as mg/kg (mg/L) without a conversion basis. Salinity is printed as µS/cm. Values are shown as printed; this profile does not claim calibration.
notes.id: N, P dan K tertulis mg/kg (mg/L) tanpa dasar konversi. Salinitas tertulis µS/cm. Nilai ditampilkan sesuai manual; profil ini tidak mengklaim kalibrasi.

notes.en: Support level stays 'documented' until a BusLink hardware test (adapter, platform, record) is recorded in evidence.hardware.
notes.id: Tingkat dukungan tetap 'documented' sampai uji perangkat keras BusLink (adapter, platform, rekaman) dicatat di evidence.hardware.
